hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that implements single-LP pools backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it fully processes each swap by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap's native liquidity math. Reverts on direct liquidity additions and donations to enforce the custom curve invariant.
